title: BACAP HP = ADVANCEMENTS
description: This datapack can bind your health and advancement count
body: This datapack add new challenge for BACAP datapack. Your health now binded to your advancements. Default settings: 50 advancements = 1 heart, heart limit = 10, notification = all, display = list. You can change every parametr for yourself, using /trigger bac.df.settings.
